decisive_items: Figure 1. Title: Recurrent Melanoma Lesions on the Left Posterior Auricular Scalp Before and After T-VEC Therapy
Figure 2. Title: Histopathologic Findings of T-VEC–Treated Melanoma Lesions

response.rationale: Vignette and figure titles explicitly state T-VEC therapy and histopathologic confirmation of complete melanoma regression; the lesion is a treated melanoma, not merely recurrent melanoma or an immune reaction.

rejected.why: Lacks the specific T-VEC treatment context and histologic confirmation of regression, which is the core finding.
Too broad; does not capture the post-therapy regression context or the definitive T-VEC association.
Describes only the inflammatory infiltrate, which is a component of the response, not the primary diagnosis.
Describes the regression phenomenon but omits the melanoma diagnosis and T-VEC treatment specificity.
